paragraphs.text: The Skeleton Ship was a legendary skeletal vessel that sailed the seas of Dominaria during the Ice Age .

The Skeleton Ship was a sailing vessel constructed from wood and bone-like material, with a hull reinforced by skeletal plates and a mast resembling elongated bones. Its sails are shown as red with skeletal motifs. Its association with Lim-Dûl implies that the ship and its crew were animated through his necromantic magic, and he may have captained the ship.
